workflows.name: Denial spike investigation
workflows.purpose: Investigate a denial-rate change and separate operational loss, payer changes and coding risk.
checks: Reconcile payer/product, service line, claim population and periods; compare counts before rates.
Segment CARC/RARC and first-pass versus final denials; distinguish unique claims from transactions.
Test policy, registration, authorization, coding and interface hypotheses against dated evidence.
Prioritize deadline exposure; draft an owner-led recovery plan and verify improvement on a later cohort.
evidence: Aligned baseline/current claims and denied counts
Actual denied dollars; contract, policy and appeal status
decisions: Revenue cycle owner validates cohorts and loss assumptions.
Coding/compliance owner reviews coding hypotheses; contracting owner verifies payer policy.
Authorized operator reviews any submission and verifies resulting receipt.
workflows.completion_gate: Verified cohorts, named owners, tested root cause and a monitored follow-up; a calculated rate is only an intermediate result.
workflows.source_policy: Keep the original aggregate report or approved source extract with its effective date. A source-family card is a lookup lead until exact text is verified.

workflows.name: Ambulatory access recovery
workflows.purpose: Turn aggregate demand, usable capacity and backlog into a testable access recovery plan.
checks: Separate requested, scheduled and completed visits; reconcile specialty, site, urgency and measurement windows.
Model usable slots and staffing; distinguish a waitlist stock from weekly demand flow.
Test capacity and demand scenarios, then validate cancellations, visit mix and underserved groups.
Name scheduling and clinical owners; track booking lead time and backlog without changing clinical priority.
evidence: Backlog as of a defined date and proposed additional slots
Visit mix, staffing constraints and cancellation assumptions
decisions: Operations owner validates usable capacity and staffing.
Compare realized lead time and equity after any authorized change.
workflows.completion_gate: Owners validate assumptions and a measured follow-up tests access improvement; no patient scheduling or clinical triage is executed.
workflows.source_policy: Keep the original aggregate report or approved source extract with its effective date. A source-family card is a lookup lead until exact text is verified.

workflows.name: Survey evidence gap review
workflows.purpose: Build a standard-to-evidence gap register with accountable owners and verification criteria.
checks: Pin accreditor/program, current standard and site scope; verify exact source text.
Map each finding to implementation evidence and a dated artifact; missing evidence differs from noncompliance.
Assign owner, due date and verification method, escalating immediate safety concerns to the responsible team.
Conduct a tracer or retest and retain unresolved conflicts; do not certify survey readiness.
evidence: Finding IDs and implementation evidence links
Owner, due date and retest method
decisions: Accreditation owner verifies the applicable standard and finding.
Qualified reviewer retests evidence and behavior.
workflows.completion_gate: Retested evidence and owner sign-off establish local progress; neither evidence presence nor this tool certifies compliance.
workflows.source_policy: Keep the original aggregate report or approved source extract with its effective date. A source-family card is a lookup lead until exact text is verified.

workflows.name: Prior authorization appeal preparation
workflows.purpose: Prepare an administrative appeal evidence map without determining medical necessity or submitting an appeal.
checks: Reconcile payer/product, service, decision reason and authorization identity in the approved environment.
Obtain the applicable policy and actual notice; use explicitly supplied deadline and receipt convention.
Map required versus available documentation and criteria; leave clinical justification to the treating clinician.
Draft a source-linked packet for accountable review, then verify authorized submission and receipt separately.
evidence: Actual notice and dated payer/product rule
Explicit decision date and appeal deadline
Required/available document names and clinical reviewer
decisions: Payer liaison verifies deadline and receipt convention.
Authorized operator approves submission and retains its receipt.
workflows.completion_gate: Reviewed packet plus verified authorized submission/receipt when requested; document completeness alone is not an approved appeal.
workflows.source_policy: Keep the original aggregate report or approved source extract with its effective date. A source-family card is a lookup lead until exact text is verified.

workflows.name: Underpayment evidence review
workflows.purpose: Reconcile expected and actual aggregate payment into a contract-linked variance packet.
checks: Pin executed contract, amendment, effective period and applicable product.
Reconcile supplied expected amounts against units, rates, carve-outs and adjustments; distinguish charges from allowed amounts.
Compare each line to paid amounts; retain overpayments and unknown expectations.
Produce a variance register and dispute draft for finance/contract review; verify any authorized payer response.
evidence: Executed contract references and effective dates
Line IDs, expected amounts and paid amounts in USD
decisions: Authorized payer liaison reviews any dispute and monitors response.
workflows.completion_gate: Validated variance with source citations and accountable disposition; arithmetic does not establish a collectible debt.
workflows.source_policy: Keep the original aggregate report or approved source extract with its effective date. A source-family card is a lookup lead until exact text is verified.

workflows.name: Discharge barrier coordination
workflows.purpose: Create an aggregate barrier workplan while preserving clinician authority and patient choice.
checks: Define cohort, window and category rules; avoid double-counting cases or days.
Validate the local avoidable-day definition and distinguish administrative blockers from clinical readiness.
Assign barrier owners and dependencies for placement, transport, coverage and services.
Review progress and equity; only authorized clinical teams determine discharge readiness.
decisions: Operational owners verify barrier resolution and preserve patient choice.
workflows.completion_gate: Verified barrier disposition and responsible-team review; a barrier summary does not authorize discharge.
workflows.source_policy: Keep the original aggregate report or approved source extract with its effective date. A source-family card is a lookup lead until exact text is verified.
